entry.description: Move the classes that shared a package with another artifact: `SpillableMemoryChannel` to `org.apache.flume.channel.spillable`, `EnvironmentVariableConfigFilter` to `org.apache.flume.configfilter.env`, `ExternalProcessConfigFilter` to `org.apache.flume.configfilter.external`, `FlumeBeanConfigurator` to `org.apache.flume.conf`, `TimestampRoundDownUtil` to `org.apache.flume.formatter.output`, `VersionInfo` and `GetJavaProperty` to `org.apache.flume.core`, and `DirectMemoryUtils` to `org.apache.flume.channel.file` in `flume-file-channel`. The `spillablememory`, `env`, `external` and `hadoop` aliases point to the new class names
